svg.title: Published Agulhas leakage transport replication
svg.desc: Exact archived experiment sections and four example trajectories accompany the 1958 to 2014 transport-weighted leakage series. West plus Northwest exits average 9.894 Sverdrups.
svg.metadata: GEOMAR archive https://hdl.handle.net/20.500.12085/b704e917-09dd-4a73-b6a1-ea24a549920c; CC BY 4.0; This is an attributed replication of archived INALT20/Parcels model output, not a new OSW simulation, observation-only estimate, present-day monitoring product, or universal leakage value. Population standard deviation describes the 57 archived annual values; no uncertainty interval is inferred. The linear trend is sensitive to the archived 1958–2014 period and forcing. Natural Earth SHA-256 9e0729ee253ca7d7a5c4ae9395fb1902264c5377c52e224d13dd85010e2835d9.
svg.text: THE LEAKAGE GATE IS A BENT LINE.
Exact archived experiment sections · four example 3-D paths · 57 transport-weighted release years

g.text: This recomputes the authors' archived model result.
It is not a new OSW simulation or a universal value.

svg.text: THE JUNCTION NOW HAS TRANSPORT WEIGHTS
The return current is larger than leakage in this experiment,
but the leakage is not one straight gate: a diagonal western
leg joins a zonal northwest leg around the Cape Basin.
SOURCE: SCHMIDT, SCHWARZKOPF, RÜHS & BIASTOCH · INALT20 / PARCELS DERIVED OUTPUT · CC BY 4.0 · POPULATION SD IS DESCRIPTIVE, NOT AN UNCERTAINTY INTERVAL
